notes: Cross-compiler toolchain lab. reasoning_depth=3: the arg-max autoregressive sampler must reproduce a documented deterministic integer transformer forward pass (embedding -> relu MLP -> logits -> first-max tie-break) fed back over a context, encoded modularly in plain C, and the polyglot requires constructing a single file that is BOTH a runnable C program (prints LANG:C) and a runnable Python-3 program (prints LANG:PY) - a genuine dual-parser construction that takes interior debugging. quantitative_correctness=3: every generated continuation, the MIPS sum, and the Fortran sum of squares are exact and the verifier recomputes hidden answers independently; the sampler continues over fresh hidden prompts not given to the agent. hidden_case_generalization=3: /app/app runs on hidden prompts (short/long, vocab-edge tokens, repeated tokens) and /app/scheme.py on hidden Scheme programs (closures, recursion, quote/list ops) and must generalize; the Fortran binary and the qemu-run MIPS binary judge hidden integer inputs. tool_breadth=3: little-endian MIPS cross toolchain + qemu-user-static, gfortran/make, gcc, the CPython interpreter, and gzip-size enforcement. Machine floor is hard (polyglot, sampler and source-cap floors are each hard).
